publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering

articleTitle: Image Classification of Rice Leaf Diseases Using Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: The problem of rice diseases around the world make to damage and fall into a large number of rice. Caused by many of types, such as; fungi, Bakteri and Viruses. which are the main causes of rice disease affected to farmers. The classification of rice can be classified into several methods. In this research, image classification is used to classify the data set of rice leaf diseases, such as; Brown Spot Rice disease (BSR), Brown Spot Rice disease (BSR), Bacterial Leaf Blight disease (BLB), which is the rice leaf disease with severe outbreaks around Thailand. Moreover, image processing technology in the classification types of rice leaf disease, such as; Random forest classification algorithm, Decision tree classification algorithm, Gradient Boosting classification algorithm and Naïve-Baye classification algorithm, which is measured by the accuracy, precision and recall of each algorithms. The best result of performance in the image classification of rice leaf diseases is random forest algorithm equal to 69.44 percent.

articleTitle: A Multichannel CNN-LSTM Network for Daily Activity Recognition using Smartwatch Sensor Data
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: Recognition of human behavior is recently an active and stimulating study. The HAR can provide valuable information on human movement and the behavior of everyday life activities. In the last decade, a large range of HAR-based applications have been implemented, such as healthcare tracking, biometric user authentication, and so on. Previously, several deep learning approaches have been introduced to focus on the issue of conventional machine learning approaches with handcrafted features. So, a novel deep learning architecture to solve the HAR problem is proposed in this study. The introduced architecture is a hybrid model called a multichannel CNN-LSTM network. The model is evaluated by state-of-the-art evaluation metrics; accuracy, precision, recall and F1-score, with a public dataset of smartwatch's accelerometer data called DHA dataset. The proposed multichannel CNN-LSTM outperforms other deep learning methods in terms of accuracy, with a score of 96.87%.

articleTitle: Thai Sign Language Recognition: an Application of Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: Thai Sign Language (TSL) is the national sign language for Thai deaf people or hearing impaired in Thailand. These people with disabilities can use sign language to communicate with people with disabilities but face obstacles in communicating daily with ordinary people. Technology should play a key role in helping disadvantaged people achieve a better quality of life. This research aims to find ways to create Thai sign language recognition applications and be developed for real-time sign language translation in the next step. We purpose a simple approach with a MediaPipe framework that helps to extract the hand landmark from video on the preprocessing step and use that landmark to build the model for recognition hand gestures with various Recurrent neural networks (RNN). The result showed that the model builds with LSTM, BLSTM and GRU has an accuracy greater than 90 percent. This approach can produce an accurate close to the traditional approach.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Algorithm Development for detection of Mango infected by Anthracnose Disease
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: The purpose of this work is to develop and design an algorithm for detection of mangoes infected with anthracnose. The study found that the higher performance ability of computers was developed and used into a deep learning system for the classification of fungal disease in plants. In the experiments, the main core of the systems is Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) was developed. In the training procedure of the systems the datasets of mango sample were divided into two parts: training and test datasets, using of 125+131 mango images with disease + without disease samples of mango photograph by the top and bottom position, in the efficiency test, 364 images from 85 + 97 images with disease + no disease samples were used for testing. Based on the testing results, the developed system was more than 70% accurate to isolate the disease mango.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment of Pregnancy-induced Hypertension Using a Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: This research aimed to develop a predictive model of the risk assessment of pregnancy-induced hypertension using a machine learning approach. Pregnancy-induced hypertension is a complication that has a serious impact on pregnant women and fetuses. It is the world's top three cause of death among pregnant women [1]. Nowadays, the exact cause of pregnancy-induced hypertension is unknown and therefore cannot be prevented. Early detection and received treatment can reduce the severity and danger. A public dataset of Logan (2020) was used in this research [2]. The dataset was collected from a casecontrol study on the determinants of 83 pre-eclampsia and five eclampsia cases among 352 pregnant women delivering in county hospitals in Nairobi, Kenya. According to the dataset, 75 percent of the pregnant women were healthy. Only 25 percent of the pregnant women were pre-eclampsia and eclampsia. Thus, this would result in a problem of an imbalanced classification when one of the two classes had more data than the other class. As such, this problem was resolved with the Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE). Risk assessment of pregnancy-induced hypertension was performed on seven machine learning algorithms, which were logistic regression (LR), K-nearest neighbor (KNN), decision tree (DT), random forest (RF), multilayer perceptron neural network(MLP), support vector machines (SVM), and naive Bayes (NB). In the experimental results, RF had the highest accuracy at 89.62 percent compared to other machine learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Real-time Water Quality Monitoring and Notification System for Aquaculture
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: Fish Farming has been transforming through various technological revolutions in recent years, the Internet of Things (IoT) provides very significant technological innovations on farming by creating a new paradigm. This paper presents a water quality monitoring system with automatic correction four types of water quality parameters. The parameters are including temperature, potential hydrogen (pH) level, turbidity, and dissolved oxygen. The system uses sensors, micro controllers, and a mobile application for acquiring and monitoring data. The notification will be sent to user when those parameters are above or below the standard values. The Arduino Nano is used as controller unit to read the analog values from the sensors. Serverless IoTs is created using Firebase Realtime Database (RTDB) and ESP8266. The experiment has been conducted at Faculty of Fisheries Technology and Aquatic Resources, Maejo University.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of LSTM-based Deep Learning Models for HAR using Smartphone Sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: Due to rapid advancement of wearable sensor technology, Human Activity Recognition (HAR) using smartphone sensors data are becoming a trendy research topic. There are many mobile applications adopting from outstanding HAR researches such as health monitoring, performance tracking of sport, and etc. In the last decade, machine learning methods have been introduced to solve the HAR problem. However, the conventional approaches were limited their performance in the process of feature extraction. With the limitation, deep learning approaches have been recently presented with outstanding performances. This paper proposed a comparative analysis of deep learning techniques for HAR using sensor data captured from accelerometer and gyroscope. In the proposed study, we employ various types of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) with Long Short-Term Memory Networks (LSTMs), disregarding the needs for hand-crafted feature extraction. The comparative results indicate that the hybrid LSTM outperforms baseline models.

articleTitle: Design of Wideband Sub-6 GHz 5G MIMO Antenna with Isolation Enhancement Using an MTM-Inspired Resonators
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes a low-profile wideband multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) antenna operated in the frequency of Sub-6 GHz 5G new radio applications. The ENG metamaterial (MTM) structures were used in isolation enhancement. The isolation of the proposed flag-shaped MIMO antenna with MTM achieved high isolation at frequency ranges of 3 - 6 GHz. The lowest transmission coefficient of -40.58 dB at 3.7 GHz. The diversity performances were investigated by the transmission coefficient (isolation), envelope correlation coefficient was less than 0.025 dB, and diversity gain was more than 9.95 dB. Furthermore, the maximum gain was 3.28 dBi at 3.1 GHz. The radiation patterns were a quasi-omnidirectional, the proposed flag-shaped MIMO antenna is suitable for Sub-6Ghz 5G new radio applications.

articleTitle: Seamless Electronic Medical Record for Health Management System in Emergency Patients
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: This paper aims to introduce health management platform based-on seamless Electronic Medical Record (sEMR) approach. The purpose of our system is to help emergency patients who need urgent care and continuous care after being discharged from the hospital or referal case and apply the modern technology to better serve the limited humans. In the research methodology, the idea of sEMR data center framework is adopted, and the system is designed for exchange emergency patients data between the community hospital and the health promoting hospital. These also test the functions, reliability, and stability of the designed sEMR system. Moreover, the experiment results represent the effectiveness and the feasibility of the system. It can be proved that the seamless electronic medical record system is created for emergency patients who need urgent care and continuous care. In additional, it can provide greater contributions to manage health data of both patients and hospitals in the future.

articleTitle: Requirements Analysis and Design for Thai Beef-Cattle Farm Management System
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: Beef cattle raising in Thailand has evolved from sub-office farming to more business farming. The cornerstone of beef cattle farming is profitable farming, which means production with a minimum number of units and the highest selling price in raising beef cattle. To achieve this, farmers need to learn and study many factors that will affect animal production. This study investigated. requirements analysis for implementation of farm management system by promote beef cattle feeding support system of smart farming based with ICT integrated. The pilot study revealed that the require of farm management and farm support system specification with stakeholder and user analysis results and also the design of beef cattle smart farming for Thai farmer's context.

articleTitle: Employee Classification for Personalized Professional Training Using Machine Learning Techniques and SMOTE
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: Training and development are essential parts of professional development that are necessary for employees to improve their capacity. Generally, professional development program is organized based on personal information, such as background, personal goal, and work experience together with business objectives and job criterion. To promote personalized training in professional development process, the proper classification of individual employee is necessary. This paper thus proposes the classification method for employee classification to promote personalized training in organizations. The machine learning based methods, Decision Tree, Random Forest, and Support Vector Machine, are studied. Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE) method is used to deal with imbalance data. The open data from Kaggle is used in this paper. For method validation, the data for training and testing are formed into three groups including 80:20, 70:30, and 60:40 respectively. The classification results show that the SMOTE can improve classification performance for all classifiers. Additionally, Random Forest performs the best classification with 96.32% accuracy.

articleTitle: Alternative-Ingredient Recommendation Based on Correlation Weight for Thai Recipes
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: Cooking is a popular activity. Most people recently use recipes on the Website, which show the ingredients that are needed for a dish and the method of cooking. However, some of the listed ingredients sometimes are not able to prepare or use for cooking for some reasons: allergies, personal preference, or some ingredients are not available in the kitchen, etc. Therefore, it should recommend the alternative-ingredients that are similar to an exchange-ingredient and suitable with remained ingredients in the recipe. This paper proposes a recommendation system of alternative ingredients for Thai recipes. The recommended method is based on the combination of the smoothed correlation weight function and graph-based approach on the Thai recipe database. Our research contributes to enhancing the cooking beginners to cook Thai food and prepare ingredients conveniently by using the alternative-ingredients.

articleTitle: IoT for Smart Farm: A Case Study of the Fertilizer Mixer Prototype
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: This research aims to 1) study, design and develop fertilizer mixer using Internet of Things. 2) develop application control the fertilizer mixer using mobile application. The results shown that the fertilizer mixer using IoT technology and conFig.d with application via smartphone. The research is divided into 2 parts: 1) hardware 2) software. The hardware using ESP32S platform for control devices and applications, Users can mix fertilizers according to the formula they want with the program that runs on their smartphones, calculating formula N-P-K to get the mixed fertilizer by weight of the fertilizer. The user can set schedule for the fertilizer mixer in 2 ways: 1) the fertilizer mixer immediately 2) set the schedule date, time for the fertilizer mixer. User can also choose from two forms of blending: 1) select according to the recommended formula or saved formula (by selecting from plant name and plant age) 2) by setting N-P-K values such as 16-20-0 or 15-1515, etc. The results of automatic fertilizer mixer was found that the automatic fertilizer mixer was able to perform the work according to the specified capacity efficiently and the error of the weight of the fertilizers from the automatic fertilizer mixer is 7% of the total weight of the required fertilizer.

articleTitle: Automatized Educational Chatbot using Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: Most of the time, students must visit universities or web pages to collect various information e.g. semester schedule, grade, curriculum, advisor info, etc. This process is time consuming and requires manpower providing such required information. Nowadays, social media and online services such as email, direct message, or live chat are becoming popular. Many students use live chat service because it is easy, fast and comfortable. However, there are some issues occurred an extensive amount of valuable time to answer by admin are wasted. Hence, in order to solve the problem properly, this article proposes an approach for building a question-answering system via chatbot technology. Because chatbots is an enable human-machine interactions with the system by the human language, which is very intuitive and user-friendly. This research objective was to develop a question-answer system in Thai using chatbot technology, which was integrated with the LINE mobile application. The experiment added a keyword in the educational domain to the dictionary and comparing word segmentation for 3 methods with text classification, combination of natural language processing (NLP) and Deep Neural Network (DNN) are used in the form of intent for text classification in this article.

articleTitle: Promoting Students Problem Solving and Teamwork Skills in Thai Undergraduates by Applying Direct Problem-Based Learning Strategy
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: This study aimed to assess the effectiveness of 1) problem-solving skill, 2) teamwork, and 3) ability to create the group project's outcome that meet the real-world problem among 42 Thai undergraduate students in a sample of Mae Fah Luang University in Chiang Rai, Thailand. The present work applied the strategy of problem-based learning to activate problem solving skill, work as a team, and also the ability to construct group project's outcome that reflect or meet the real-world problem. The results revealed the application of PBL strategy improved the problem solving of students significantly, the high performance of role playing in a team, as well as the outcome of the group project that meet current real-world situation and environment.

articleTitle: The Effect of Sound in VR Exergame to Adult Player: A Primary Investigation
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: A serious game is a new concept of game development that is a digital game created to entertain and achieve an objective or learning at least one other goal. Ascribable, the digital game has affected of player motivation, and users gain emotional level. Like the reward system, sound is typically embedded as a part of game mechanics and affecting player`s motivation. The research aims to explore how the game components affect the motivation in virtual reality (VR) exergames. We evaluated the impact of the immersive rehabilitation system on motivation and affect. We conducted a study with 5 participants to compare the motivation in VR exergame with enabling and disable the sound system because We preliminary employ the formative evaluation to evaluate the in-depth detail of sounds effect to the player experience. Participants reported significant improvements in motivation and engagement in the experiment to enable system conditions than questionnaires and performance players. In conclusion, the sound system is an inclination key feature to increase motivation in exergame. We derive a design experiment for future research: (1) Increasing participants in virtual reality exergame experiments. (2) Addition decibel sound chat to compare with a sound system. (3) Addition a new method player performance with motivation.

articleTitle: Music Generator for Elderly Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: This research proposes a new simple music generator for elderly music instruments. This music generator can generate new music in ABC notation. It composes a new melody using LSTM to rearrange existing music bars from the original melody. The input of LSTM features is note patterns in particular music bars that are transformed and encoded as hash table using WTA technique. Through music creation processes, we set the beginning music bars and let the ending music bars to be set automatically. We, then, feed the beginning music bars to the trained model to find following music bars of the music content. Therefore, the result showed the music split into 3 parts: the beginning, the middle and the end. The experiment displayed a recreation of music pieces from the original header with a 1: 10 aspect ratio and had the same number of music bars as the original ones. The music outcomes would differ significantly from the originals by measuring the differences by comparing each a bar lines between generated and original music in the same position with the XOR function.

articleTitle: Optimized Classification for Organizational Workload
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: The classification of workload for companies or organizations consumes a lot of resources. Especially for smaller organizations, excessive resource use can lead to an imbalance in systems. Machine learning principles such as Naive Bayes can effectively reduce costs and manageability as it can reuse the organization's sources or statistics and can be reused without any administration. However, the performance of such an algorithm may deteriorate by itself due to improper deployment during data analysis. This study aims to optimize the Naive Bayes algorithm for classifying workload levels focusing on the distributions and the relevant kernels, including Gaussian, Kernel, Box, Epanechnikov, and Triangle. The optimized classification method offers better accuracy along with other performances. The results of the optimized method can be well applied to models that are similar to the proposed model.

articleTitle: System Requirement and Development of Open Source for Library Automation in Laos PDR
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: This paper aims to solve the problem and development of the automatic library program that supports the user in Lao PDR and enable the libraries of college educational institutions in Laos PDR to access database and exchange the information technology to each other by using Interoperability Model. This program has tested 4 state colleges in Laos PDR. We applied a spiral model to design and develop the prototype of library automation which supports Laos language and the basic requirement of librarian behavior. This approach can be useful to the college educational institutions in Laos PDR for using it in the future.

articleTitle: A Performance Comparison of Supervised Classifiers and Deep-learning Approaches for Predicting Toxicity in Thai Tweets
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: There are numerous tweeter user accounts in Thailand and many toxic comments are being generated every day on this platform. Sentimental Analysis can be used as a tool to identify toxic comments. In this study, two feature extraction techniques, including Bag of Words (BOW) and Term frequency-inverse document (TF-IDF), were investigated. Additionally, the performance of ten well-known traditional classifiers, along with three deep-learning approaches including Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Long-short-term memory (LSTM) and pretrained Bidirectional Encoder Representations (BERT), were compared with the public Toxicity Thai tweeter corpus. The experiments reveal that by combining Bag of Words (BOW) with the Extra-Tree classifier, researchers were able to archive the highest F1-score of 0.72, classification accuracy rate of 72.27% and AUC value of 0.77 using the test set in contrast to other classifiers and other deep-learning techniques. Feature importance, correlation and impacts were also investigated through the use of SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) diagram.

articleTitle: Exploring Tourist Behavior from Social Media Using Geotagged Photographs
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we propose an approach for exploring tourists’ behavior based on the extracted dataset from geotagged photographs. We transform the dataset to a suitable format type and apply k-mean clustering to cluster the different tourists’ behavior. After that, the tourists’ behavior of each cluster, especially behavior regards interesting attraction, has been analyzed by statistical test. Entropy also has been employed to measure the diversity of place in each attraction category for presenting each clusters’ characteristics. The results have been demonstrated that k-mean clustering presents the tourists’ behavior into eight groups and each of the tourists prefers conspicuously different attractions.

articleTitle: The Development of 2D Animation media to promote tourism in Wat Phra That Lampang Luang, Lampang Province
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: The development of 2D animation media is a tool that uses the strength and power of animation to communicate easily. It serves to make content memorable and this media then helps to promote tourism more effectively in Wat Phra That Lampang Luang, Lampang Province. The research process uses a target audiences of those interested in tourist attractions in Lampang Province, rely on online travel information and are aged from 15 to 30 years old, the assessment is divided into two parts: first to assess the effectiveness of the media to promote tourism. And the second is to assess the production quality of the media. Part one of the study noted the effectiveness of 2D animation media to promote tourism, show value and importance, and encourage interest in travel and aesthetics. Satisfaction was very good, which suggests that 2D animation media indeed has an effect on tourism interest. The second part of the study found that the production quality, content, design, visual aspects and animation of the 2D media was of a high standard. The audio aspect is sufficient, which shows that the quality of 2D animation production affects perception because it is consistent with the results of the first part of the study.

articleTitle: Scalability and Robustness Testing for Open Source Web Crawlers
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: This paper implemented the proposed framework. It focuses on evaluating the crawlers based on scalability and robustness on e-commerce websites. The scalability is a feature that the system can adapt to the amount of data continuing to increase, and the performance does not decrease. The robustness is an ability that can handle exceptions when web crawlers are crawling. Multiple testing environments were set up on e-commerce websites. Scalability testing and robustness testing were used to measure the scalability and robustness of web crawlers. The scalability attributes and robustness failure rate were used to quantify the scalability and robustness. Statistical methods such as the Friedman test and the Nemenyi test were used to analyze the significant differences among crawlers. The experimental results show Heritrix, Scrapy, and Nutch have the best overall scalability. In the non-interference test, Scrapy has the best robustness. However, Webmagic, Webcolletor, and Gecco have the best robustness in the interference test based on general test and database test.Testing, Rrιhrιrtneτc Testirrg, E-comrnerce websites.

articleTitle: Automatic Pencil Sketch Landscape Image Generation From Photograph
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: This paper presents an automatic pencil sketch landscape image generation form photograph. The algorithm is generating the pencil sketch image based on the Sobel operator. The texture noise is eliminated using the Gaussian low-pass filter. The kernel of the low-pass filter is adaptive based on the tone of the input image. The evaluation of this algorithm was done using the online questionnaire, and the results are expectable by the experts in art and photography.

articleTitle: A Case Study in Class User Interface Design of Problem-Based Learning Modeling (UIDPBL)
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: Problem-Based Learning (PBL) is a student oriented learning method that using real-life practical problems to start the learning process in order to encourage problem solving skills. In User Interface Design course, the teaching and learning are not only focus on the theoretical knowledge but also focus on motivating students in soft skills. Therefore, this research purposes a Class User Interface Design of Problem-Based Learning Modeling (UIDPBL) in order to promote the 21st century of 4Cs skills - communication, collaboration, creativity, and critical thinking skills. The proposed model applies the PBL concept to the class User Interface Design. The study is evaluated by both summative assessment and formative assessment. The student learning out come as the final grading and student feedback from a questionnaire at the end of the UIDPBL cycle are taken into account. The results presented that our proposed model, UIDPBL, is able to encourage students to gain the 21st century of 4Cs skills.

articleTitle: Design and Deployment of Online PBL Model for High School Students Promoting Collaborative Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: Problem (Project) Based Learning has been applied successfully in many fields in many higher educational institutions worldwide to develop learning efficiency though idea exchanging, debating and interacting. Students learn how to analyze the given problems, develop thinking s and self-study skills from learning activities in the classroom. Recently, COVID-19 is a major factor contributing to the digital transformation for learning. From offline to online learning, all students are required to adapt their preference of normal learning including high school students. This paper presents the design and the deployment of online Problem (Project) Based Learning for high school students so that enhance their learning efficiency and develop collaborative learning skill required for the future employment.

articleTitle: The Design and Development of Thai Cultural Inspiration to Animation Character
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: This creative research aims to re-design the set of characters from Navagraha or nine planets deities in Thai culture to a contemporary form of sci-fi animation characters and influence younger generation to interest in Thai art and culture. The research tool is content analysis and character design process model. The principles and theories used in this research are semiotics, design principle and psychological theories which support the design of physical and psychological structures of characters. The result of this research is a concept design of nine planets deities. The concept has two forms for each character: one is traditional dress and other form is in sci-fi look armor. The survey of this character development found the young generation are interested to the story and look forward to animated feature film, graphic novel, or game.

articleTitle: Placement Effect of Motion Sensors for Human Activity Recognition using LSTM Network
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: There are various possibilities for wearable sensors to determine the recognition of human condition. In order to theoretically drive with wearable sensor technology, several difficult issues have been studied and solved. We currently succeeded in computing the efficient high performance deep learning model for the sensor-based human activity recognition (HAR). There is, however, an influence study challenge regarding the impact of the body-mounted sensor position on the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network. In this work, we propose to conduct several experiments in order to discover the optimal placement for each physical activity. The experimental results show that by using heterogeneous sensor data fusion, the chest position is ideal for physical activity identification with a maximum accuracy of 94.18%.

articleTitle: A simple Analog to Digital Converter for Capacitive Sensors
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes a simple analog to digital converter for capacitive sensor. The complete system is based on a Sigma-Delta modulator and composed with a current to voltage converter, an integrator, a comparator and a one-bit digital to analog converter as a feedback current. The Sigma-Delta modulator is able to deliver directly a bitstream with a ratio of logical high directly proportional to the differential capacitance to be measured. The proposed circuit has been designed and simulated through PSPICE software. Theoretical analysis and simulated results are analyzed.

articleTitle: An IoT-Based Controlled Ankle Motion Boot for Foot and Ankle Monitoring During the Recovery Phase
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: If not treated properly, a foot or ankle injury could result in long-term impairments or a prolonged recovery phase for the patient. In order to facilitate orthopedic doctors in optimizing treatment for patients, we propose a foot/ ankle monitoring system which consists of a Controlled Ankle Motion (CAM) boot, a microcontroller, sensors, and a web application. The microcontroller with the sensors on the CAM boot monitors and analyzes exerted weight, humidity, acceleration, and angular velocity of a patient's injured foot or ankle during the recovery phase. The sensor values are sent wirelessly to a database and visualized on a web application. The proposed system will benefit doctors and patients in rehabilitation. The patients can gain a better understanding of how to follow through with the treatments and the doctors can monitor patient movements even after having left the hospital.

articleTitle: An Improved Automatic Zone Detection Algorithm based on Mechanic Flow for Complex Scene Event
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: Due to the objects detection and an complex background in the scene, the accuracy and stability of the tracking algorithm are often interrupt. Therefore, The accurately objects tracking and zone detection in the scene are difficult problem in object tracking applications. A robust zone detection method is proposed to solve the problem of occlusion. It adopt weight ideas in mechanism design. In order to modulate the problems of background issue, object detection is firstly divide into blocks and the different weights are related with motion direction for each blocks. In addition, we proposed the weight mechanism for keeping the object and tracking when object disappear in the scene. Additional, The experiments represent that our algorithm can be achieved the performance in handling various complex videos surveillance both vehicles and persons detection.

articleTitle: Evaluation System for Car Engine Performance
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: Detailed engine performance measurements and problematic identification are helpful to drivers in reducing communication errors between customer and maintenance operators as well as the cost of operations. Therefore, this study aims to develop an evaluation system for assessing car performance by using an embedded system that consists of an engine performance application and display. It can solve such problems by applying embedded technology in combination with ultra-wideband communication technology that interacted with the Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID). This wireless communication system resists the interference of the interior engine compartment and processes the retrieval data from PID before transferring it to display as current performance.

articleTitle: Performance and Analysis of PI and Fuzzy Controlled Zeta Converter Fed in PMBLDC Motor Drive
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: Right now work examination to achieve wanted degree of execution, the PMBLDC drive requires appropriate power quality improvement. Converter took care of PMBL DC motor drive show nonlinear attributes subsequently power quality of system aggravation at AC input supply, for example, poor or low pf, expanded THD and high cf. The primary target of this work propose, recreate and research system for refining quality of power of systems at AC supply utilizing power calculate adjustment procedures PMBLDC motor drives. For this dynamic PFC method-utilizing single-arrange converters be assessed because of their ease and straightforwardness. It is seen that the force quality is improved by utilizing zeta converter with diminished THD and better effectiveness. In this way, the zeta converter which constrained by FLC and PI have simulated in MATLAB. The effect has been examined by supplanting PI controller with FLC.

articleTitle: The Conceptual Model of Digital Transformation for Small and Medium Enterprises in Thailand
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: In today's market, the survival or extinction of companies depend on their adaptability to the new digital environment. Digital transformation is known as a strategy that intends to achieve greater business outcomes. Previously, the project called “Northern Digital Economy” was launched which aimed to promote the utilization of technology in small and medium enterprises (SMEs) in the northern region of Thailand. Therefore, the conceptual model of digital transformation for Thai SMEs has been created and developed within the project. The digital transformation conceptual model's list of elements in three categories and five states are presented throughout this paper.

articleTitle: Chinese Oral Ability Incubator Using LIA, CoPs and AAR
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: With the growing importance and influence of China's economy globally, how to apply Chinese language in real life becomes a challenge for overseas students. This study aims to identify the critical issues of Chinese teaching and learning taking CCAA (College of Chinese & ASEAN Arts) as an example. Samples are 10 Asian students from Thailand, Korea and Laos. The results show that grammar based and content based teaching account 87.5% of Chinese class which causes CCAA Asian students unnatural oral performance. To bring up international students' oral ability, this study proposes a solution model by applying LIA, CoPs and AAR to transfer CCAA Asian students productive knowledge as well as highlight the practical through both in-class and out of class activities.

Author Keywords: grammar based and content based teaching

articleTitle: A Cooperative Education Management System using Technology Acceptance Model
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: Information management system for cooperative education is a part of the cooperative project operation among entrepreneurs, universities, lecturers, and students to enhance student's experience during their studies with the actual establishment. There are various processes during the project, such as students selection for joining the project, entrepreneur selection, lecturer assessment, report issue of project management by project staff, and information summary of the management report. Different from original cooperative operation with a hard copy, the concept of information management system is designed and developed based on the SDLC Process and Laravel development framework, respectively. A representational state transfer API software architecture is also applied with the management information system which helps to support all types of user system operations. Approximately 700 students in a semester are selected for data analysis for descriptive statistics such as percentage, standard deviation, mean, and frequency. The results of the study found that satisfaction scores are: 1) at a high level of overall website design and layout, 2) at a high level of the user satisfaction, and 3) at the highest level of the overall performance of the website utilization.

articleTitle: Ontology Model for Automatic Duplication Reducing for Industrial Standard Assessment
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: The entrepreneurs found that data science was redundant and wasteful of management resources in several industry-standard assessments which are duplicated. Due to the lack of advanced technology professionals, the application of highly complex technology is a barrier to implementation. Ontology models and artificial intelligence are effective means of solving such problems. Therefore, this study aims to address the ontological problems that can interpret and rule out complex artificial intelligence issues and ambiguous interpretations. It allows quick and repeatable actions to be performed automatically without an administrator. The proposed ontology model reflects the requirements in the industry-standard while K-Nearest Neighbor (K-NN) algorithm separates the data groups and integrated assessment suite that minimizes the redundancy of requirements from standards.

articleTitle: Lifestyle Classification for Recommendation of Excessive Sugar Consumption in Thai Teenagers
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: Healthy food consumption is one of the most important aspects of life. Consuming adequate nutrition may not only keep healthy but also prevent many diseases. The consumption of sugar should be given the same attention, as many foods, especially in Thailand, are prepared with sugar as the main ingredient. In addition, the personal health and behavior of consuming excessive amounts of sugar per day are neglected by ordinary consumers as well as teenagers and they are not properly recommended by experts. This study aims to create an automated, accurate, and suitable lifestyle classification of a recommendation system for Thai teenagers with different lifestyles and health conditions. A model of the decision tree was proposed in this study along with the optimized metric. The data is collected from 349 teenagers. The results show that the decision tree with Information Gain provides the highest accuracy of 95.90%.

articleTitle: Techniques of 3D Visualization using Unmanned Aerial Vehicle for Flood Protection
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: During the human history floods have been an integral part of the evolution. This paper mostly presents the principle of aerial mapping with high resolution for flood protection using Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV/Drone) in Ing river- Kwan Phayao lake, Phayao province, northern part of Thailand. GIS is ideally suited as an instrument for the performance of data derived from continuous monitoring of locations and used to support and bring information to ecological managers and the community. Aerial images with high resolution of 4.38cm was processed for the base map of the flood map. Moreover, the result was presented the direction of the sediment from Ing river to Kwan Phayao lake.

articleTitle: The Mobile Application for Promoting Community-Based Tourism: A Case Study of Baan Muang-Ruang Community, Mueang District, Chiang Rai Province
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: The purposes of this research were (1) to develop and evaluate the efficiency of tourism application for Baan Muang-Ruang community, (2) to examine user’s satisfaction towards tourism application for Baan Muang-Ruang community, and (3) to investigate the results of tourism promotion by Baan Muang-Ruang community for implementation of tourism application at Baan Muang-Ruang community. The evaluation of tourism applications efficiency in Baan Muang-Ruang community employed 10 experts in examining the application that included application developers, website developers, UX/UI designers, and 52 representatives of tourism community villagers and tourists selected by convenience sampling. The research instruments were tourism application for Baan Muang-Ruang community, performance assessment, user satisfaction questionnaire, and tourism promotion assessment for Baan Muang-Ruang Community towards implementation of tourism application for Baan Muang-Ruang Community. The data was analyzed for mean and standard deviation. The results showed that tourism application assessment by experts revealed overall while user satisfaction towards the tourism application for Baan Muang-Ruang was rated at the highest level, and the results of the tourism promotion rated by the community, in overall, was at the moderate level.

articleTitle: Metrics-based Knowledge Analysis in Software Design for Web-based Application Security Protection
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: During this period of high-speed internet, there are a number of serious challenges for software security protection of software design, especially throughout the life cycle of the process of software design, in which there are various risks involving information interaction. Significant information leakage can result from a lack of technical support and software security protection. One major problem with regard to creating software that includes security is the way that secure software is defined and the methods that are used for the measurement of security. The point of this research work is on the software engineers' perspective regarding security in the stage of software design. The tools for the measurement of the metrics are employed for the evaluation of the software's security. In this case study, a metric category of design are used, which are assumed to provide quantitative data about the software's security.

articleTitle: Implementation of Container Based Parallel System for Automation Software Testing
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: Software quality assurance (QA) is the most important parts of the software development life cycle. Currently, software testing is widely used for automation testing. Two of the popular tools are robot framework and selenium2. Furthermore, software testing has major methods based on Black-box (or functional) testing and White-box (or structural) testing. In order to decrease execution time and improve resource management, the parallel paradigm can be a key concept. Thus, to create the parallel paradigm, we propose the use of selenium-robot-framework Docker container with the parallelization agent. The results show that the 4 workers case of parallelization not only decreased to one-third of the execution time of 1 worker case but also used all physical CPU cores quite similar around 50%. Furthermore, we show how the parallel paradigm using containers and the software automation testing tool beneficial to the significance of resource management.

articleTitle: Importance of Digital Arts in Interdisciplinary Context
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: The Digital Arts course was introduced in 2015 in IIT Mandi to empower students with computer graphics skills to learn to develop visual content for explaining their research. It was appropriate as its practitioners can use these skills as scientists, researchers, and educators. Computer graphics development for pragmatic contributions to interdisciplinary research has collaborated between art, design, science, and technology. The course content introduced involves 2D graphics, animation, movie creation, and editing skills. This paper is based on experts' views about the subject and areas and students involved in the Digital Art course introduced to them as an interdisciplinary course at IIT Mandi from 2015-17. This paper is the actual observation about the importance of course activities, students' works, and fellow faculty members' requirements in various fields.

articleTitle: Analysing Blinded People EEG Signals while Touching using Lightweight Device
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: Several countries in the world had a greater number of blinded people. The ways they learn are using sound or tactile pictures. In this paper, authors observed and analyze electroencephalogram signals of them while they learn about the meaning of tactile pictures by inexpensive device. Methods of this paper were collecting dataset by OpenVIBE program, data analyzing by Fast Fourier Transform algorithm and data comparisons by using statistical mean and standard deviation. Results of experiments showed EEG waves, delta, theta, beta and gamma signal during touching were higher than meditation period. Results showed blinded people use more creative, recall and imaginary for learning about pictures. In addition, they used muscle to control touching behaviors.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Self-directed Learning through Problem-based Learning in the Online Class During Covid-19 Epidemic
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: This paper presents the initial implementation of online Self-directed learning (SDL) framework to support teaching and learning during Covid-19 epidermic. The investigation is conducted on the first-year student who enrolls in the Art composition class; the total example is 67 students. The result is framing the SDL to suit the online course, pre-test, learning goals, and outcomes setting. Teaching style surveying and the initial feedback and self-assessment are also employed.

articleTitle: Adaptive Learning Rate for Dealing with Imbalanced Data in Classification Problems
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: This research modified a backpropagation learning algorithm in order to increase its ability to deal with imbalanced data problems. We used the backpropagation algorithm and a concept of multiple adaptive learning rates to train the feedforward neural network. Using multiple adaptive learning rates allowed us to achieve a classification model that had fewer problems when dealing with an imbalanced dataset. The experimental results showed that the proposed method performed significantly better than the conventional backpropagation neural network in all tests.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Usability Evaluation Methods on a Hyper Casual Game
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: There are many usability evaluation criteria proposed in the past, and each has different limitations. To find the best usability evaluation method for a hyper-casual game, we present a comparative study on three usability evaluation methods; Concurrent Thinking Aloud (TA), Retrospective Think Aloud (RTA), and Interviewing. We test each method with 30 students by comparing the number of problems detected, experimenting time, and analysis time. We found that RTA found 80% of usability problems by experimenting with 14 participants. TA needed about 24 participants to find the number of problems. However, even if we experiment the interviewing method with 30 students, we find only 64.70% of problems. Although the interviewing is not useful in finding the maximum number of usability problems, we find that it takes the minimum time to operate. RTA required the longest experimenting time, and TA required the longest analysis time.

articleTitle: A Decentralized Privacy Zone for Health Domain
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: Since lives generate in the world, more and more people have learnt and realized that `There is no secret'. Even though, people best try to keep their personal data for private, secure, and confident. However, the digital era arises, open the gate of connection between people, and object wisely, over high-technology network. Increasingly and rapidly the instances of breaches in the security of large amounts of electronically stored personal data users concern about their privacy issues. For the case, in health domain, all patients (data owners) are pleased to share their data for medical doctor (and hospital), expecting better healthcare treatment. Since people know their data and network behaviors are being observed all the time they shared. Unfortunately, they do not sure and know, how to evaluate the true quality of individual privacy data to sharing zone? In order to cross this obstacle, this paper suggests a model to manage the privacy of data in decentralized concept. This can ensure and more comfort for data owner to share their privacy information. As well as to provide decision makers, system providers, and all relevant parties are using with valuable data and improve their ability to make critical decisions on health related programs.

articleTitle: Agricultural Year-Round Planning Model for Market-oriented Farms
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: Nowadays farmers face agricultural product price problem because tradesmen offer low prices, and grow plants without plans and market demand examination. This results in lack and over-supply of some products. In addition, most of farmers lack of processing knowledge suitable for market demand. Therefore, agricultural year-round planning should be organized as market demands in order to increase the farm potentiality for the market competition. This paper proposes an agricultural year-round planning model for market-oriented farms which analyzes agricultural raw materials for year-round planning and farmer abilities categorized by plants based on the market demands. The model is available to access via web application. It is tested and evaluated by 5 heads of farmer union in different areas and 2 agriculture entrepreneurs. The evaluated results show that the model can decide the results of year-round planning as farmer abilities, areas, and quantity as the demands correctly. It also provides 4.46 average satisfaction score from 7 users.

articleTitle: The Implementation of Virtual Reality Technology in Education: the Perspective of Learning Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: Since Virtual Reality (VR) was first mentioned in the 1950s, the research interest into the technology has been widely concerned. Virtual Reality (VR) provides immersion and interactivity with reality. Since their incorporation into classrooms and labs in over a hundred countries, visual innovations have significantly enhanced the availability of advanced concepts to be challenged in a manner that portrays them more realistically than the terms that they mean. Virtual reality enables specialists and technicians to conduct their duties more efficiently by acquiring a greater awareness of their strategic placement. In this study, databases of Google scholars, Scopus, web of science etc. were used for extensive literature retrieval, and excel was used for analysis. The results show that the advantages of incorporating haptic feedback device into the VR systems and how these integrated systems can allow students to compete realistically in the complex machine-assisted learning and experimental process. we need to admit the importance of educating people about how simple it is for scientists to perform chemical simulations using Virtual Reality.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Nature Based Algorithms to Determine The Relevant Factor on Customer Relationship Problem
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: The change of business environments leads to highly competitive in each industry such as hotel business. The business process needs to be adapted in order to obtain the quick response towards their customer. The customer relationship management is one of the most important processes to be changed. The resource allocation in the business should be considered. The channel to contact customers such as social network needs the various resources and driving factors. The management level may need decision support system which can help to determine the relevant factors and resources from the large data dataset. Therefore, the data mining technique should be incorporated. Grey Wolf Algorithm which is Nature Based Algorithm is proposed to implement on Social CRM data. It will analyze in terms of feature selection to obtain the improved performance on decision making towards driving factors of Social CRM. The data of Social CRM based on hotel business has been collected and analyze using Grey Wolf Algorithm. The results are shown that the Grey Wolf Algorithm provided the accuracy rate at 83.33 per cent for Social CRM data set and it can imply that the algorithm help to determine the relevant factor on the Social CRM in terms of decision making. In addition, there is a comparison result of the Grey Wolf Algorithm among other datasets which is comparable performance on the feature selection and accuracy rate.

articleTitle: POPBL-Blended Learning Model to Enhance Student Performance in Integrated Modular Learning Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: The significant growth of digital technology has impacted all areas of business from small to the enterprise. To develop business entrepreneur capable of applying knowledge to solve complex problem in real world business has been challenged. Digital Technology for Business Innovation (DTBI) program of study has been designed for learners to accomplish business entrepreneurship which adapts digital technologies to find applicable solutions. To promote the learning performance of DTBI students having diverse background, this paper proposes a blended learning model employing POPBL and integrated-modular course framework which can lead students to achieve ultimate outcome of real digital business initiation. The student performance is evaluated by group project work and individual with both of formative and summative assessments. The evaluation result shows good qualification and satisfaction scores as well as enhancement evidence.

articleTitle: An Implementation of Programmable Oscillator for Inductive-Loop Vehicle Sensor Using Low-Cost Microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: this paper presents the implementation of automatic oscillator tuning for inductive loop vehicle sensor. The implementation is based on a series of an oscillator, a resonance circuit, and microcontroller to capture the output of the resonance circuit. Three programmable oscillators are proposed and compared. The experiment was done on 24 combinations of loop wire and capacitor to simulate the different real-world scenarios. The results are concluded that the proposed method is correctly locating the resonance frequency and create output signal that highly distinctive between positive and negative detected case.

articleTitle: Computer Modelling of Richardson’s Mathematical Model
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: This paper suggests a computer model for prediction about the occurrence of an armed conflict between two countries or two organizations based on the Richardson's arms race mathematical model. The Richardson model was the first application of dynamic modeling in the field of international relations. Richardson used his model to describe the arms race between Austria-Hungary and Germany on the one hand, and Russia and France on the other, in the period of 1909-1913. This simulated computer model which based on the Richardson's arms race mathematical model allows not only to predict the outcome of the arms race, but also allows the user to apply the model for analyzing of how to reduce the probability of war. Three examples and two exercises are presented in the paper to get more clear understanding on how our implemented program works. The aim of the work is to show the possibility of armed conflicts using practical application of computer simulation based on the Richardson approach.

articleTitle: Automatic Thermal Stress Level Measurement System in Dairy Cows
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: Holstein-Friesians are a breed of dairy cattle that like cold weather so they cannot tolerate high temperature in Thailand. Dairy farming in Thailand is inevitably faced with heat stress, as Thailand is a tropical country. Therefore, dairy cows were developed as a crossbred Holstein with local dairy cows to improve immunity and better weather resistance, but dairy cows were also affected by heat stress. The effect of heat stress is decreased milk production, dairy health problems. The solution to the heat stress problem of dairy farmers is to monitor the panting behavior of the dairy cows, measure the temperature in the dairy farm, and then reduce the heat stress in the dairy cows by turning on the ventilation fans, mixing roughage to increase the feeding of dairy cows. These solutions are to help increase the milk yield of dairy cows and also reduce the morbidity of dairy cows. However, solving the heat stress problem in dairy cows as mentioned requires both time and human resources to monitor the symptoms of dairy cows, the authors therefore proposed a system for automatic thermal stress level measurement in dairy cows by measuring the heat stress level in dairy cows using the Temperature Humidity Index (THI) equation to calculate the heat stress level in dairy cows and alert via Line Notify to dairy farmers in real time using microcontroller board in system development.

articleTitle: The Development of Application for Advice and Diagnosis of Diseases in Dogs
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: The research aims to study and design an application to advise and diagnose dog's health. In this work, the development process of the application not only present but also the performance of the application usage evaluated. This work consists of the following two steps. Firstly, we present the software development process from collecting the user requirement to the software installation. Next, the evaluation of the application usage is obtained from a questionnaire, collected from users. The user can be divided into two groups: expert-users and end-users. The collected data analyzed and presented by the mean and standard deviation. The experimental results show that the satisfaction level is good. Therefore, the proposed work can widely use as a first diagnose dog's health tool.

articleTitle: Large-Scale Instance Selection using Center of Principal Components
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: One-hot encoding is one of the most popular data preprocessing methods used to convert categorical data into numerical data before applying a training classification model. Drawbacks of one-hot encoding are its high memory consumption and large storage requirements when the training set has many categorical columns. To overcome these drawbacks, we proposed the PC-CS method to reduce the training set size by only selecting principal components center as a representative instance of each disjoint partition. The proposed method was compared with two instance selection methods and the full training model as the baseline model. We used five datasets from the UCI dataset repository website. Evaluation of the classification performance involved four classifier algorithms: decision tree, naive Bayes, support vector machine, and logistic regression. The average classification performance of the proposed PC-CS method was approximately 2% higher than those of the other algorithms tested, while the reduction rate was about 5% higher.

articleTitle: A Study of Supply Chain and the Marketing Mix of Tai Lue Woven Fabric in Phayao Province, Thailand
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: Tai Lue woven fabric is a unique product producing in northern Thailand. This research studies the current supply chain activities of the Tai Lue community in Phayao province, Thailand by using the SCOR model. It found that the business is lacking planning in terms of making products and make-to-stock entities. In addition, the marketing mix is used to evaluate the disadvantages in the Tai Lue woven fabric business. It found that the business of Tai Lue textile still needs to improve. Shop settings and products need more fashionable design and store salespeople should know their products deeply in detail.

articleTitle: Asset Management System on Somsri.io
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: Somsri.io is developed for a school management system to analyze data for planning and connecting parents through modern channels in the platform of web application which is developed by using Ruby on Rails, Angular JS, and jQuery to improve school management. The problem of the Somsri.io system is caused by the lack of the Assets Management System (AMS) which is an important module for supporting a school management system. The lack of AMS often has problems which consist of returned assets delay time and redundancy requested assets. The AMS requires for development to solve these problems. So the AMS is developed on MVC pattern and consists of asset request, asset repair, asset history, and supplier service to increase the efficiency of school management for Somsri.io. The experiment found that the AMS increase performance in asset management.

articleTitle: Mixed Learning Strategies on Combining Horizontal Blended Learning with Flipped Classroom
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: In Thailand, blended learning was introduced to be the strategy for teaching management during the COVID-19 pandemic situation. Therefore, the proposed combined model of horizontal blended learning with flipped classroom was designed to help the lecturers to organize the online teaching for their students. The idea is to focus on two event activities, one is the self-learning through the LMS and another is the wrapped-up lecture by the facilitator. The 30% of activities are the face-to-face class organized for the formative assessment with the students. Additionally, the class is conducted in both synchronous and asynchronous modes. The case study is conducted with the Information Technology students who enrolled in the Introduction to Cloud Computing course. As the results, the proposed teaching model can enhance the students' knowledge retention more than those of the traditional classroom with the t-Test analysis show its significance of Pvalue at $0.014 \lt 0.05$. The attitude tests of the students can confirm that the proposed model is suitable for a disruptive situation like the COVID-19 pandemic.

articleTitle: CIA Analysis for LoraWAN Communication Model
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: IoT technologies have helped to advance numerous industries and innovations. Agriculture is one of the key industries in Thailand that is crucial for the country's economic growth. Therefore, many IoT devices and applications for agricultural industries have been created. LoraWan is one of the IoT communication protocols that was applied to various smart farm applications. As a result, IoT deployments can create complex and vulnerable systems. This paper analyzes the security factors of the LoRaWan system based on the Cybersecurity Cube, which is a three-pronged framework for computer security and information protection. The study offers important security details for agricultural IoT communications.

articleTitle: Village Health Volunteers (Volunteers) with Information Technology Amidst the COVID-19 Epidemic
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: During the COVID-19 epidemic, volunteer duties are The front line in the function of screening, fever testing, visiting homes or inquiring information of the people in the community makes “technology” applied to the work of the MCOTs to increase efficiency. “SMART MC” is an application designed for convenient Health information Between PSU and the public can install both Android and IOS systems. The preliminary work of the application has online data transmission system to the central Provincial level to national level (Network of family doctors, staff Public health) to follow up the work of the volunteer volunteers, as well as to provide public health officials with access to information of the volunteers in the are more clearly. It also sends information to certified the news from the Department of Health Service Support, Ministry of Public health directly to the volunteers, such as health information, epidemic prevention methods, etc.

articleTitle: An Efficient Congestion Control Model utilizing IoT wireless sensors in Information-Centric Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: Congestion control is one of the essential keys to enhance network efficiency so that the network can perform well even in the case of packet drop. This problem is even more challenging in Information-Centric Networking (ICN), a typical Future Internet design, which employs the packet flooding policy for forwarding the information. To diminish the high traffic load due to the huge number of packets in the era of the Internet of Things (IoT), this paper proposes an effective caching and forwarding algorithm to diminish the congestion rate of the IoT wireless sensor in ICN. The proposed network system utilizes accumulative popularity-based delay transmission time for forwarding strategy and includes the consecutive chunks-based segment caching scheme. The evaluation results using ndnSIM, a widely-used ns-3 based ICN simulator, demonstrated that the proposed system can achieve less interest packet drop rate, more cache hit rate, and higher network throughput, compared to the relevant ICN-based benchmarks. These results prove that the proposed ICN design can achieve higher network efficiency with a lower congestion rate than that of the other related ICN systems using IoT sensors.

articleTitle: Improving the Accuracy of Forecasting PM2.5 Concentrations With Hybrid Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2021 Joint International Conference on Digital Arts, Media and Technology with ECTI Northern Section Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering
abstract: The problem of substandard air quality in northern Thailand has been found over the past decades. One of the current methods used by the government agencies to mitigate the problem is to release the burning control measures. A forecasting technique has been widely used as an effective approach for supporting government agencies to set the period for the measures.
